notes: Adds switchable monthly knowledge checks. When enabled, each active user gets 3 random multiple-choice questions once per calendar month from current safety information assigned to them. Each question has 3 choices and one correct answer; 3/3 completes the month. Formal training renewal schedules are unchanged. OFF creates no due/overdue status, history is retained, and re-enabling starts with the current month only. Admin can build/review version-aware question banks; Admin/Manager can view monthly completion status.
